text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Hero...
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Arima Kinen, the story's 
climax. To become the hero everyone 
acknowledges, Zenno Rob Roy aims to seize 
the final crown of the Autumn Senior 
Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Hero...
text_block_list.text:
Will the late-blooming hero finally seize 
victory this time?
Or will the Pitch-Black 
Emperor stand in his way? —The curtain 
rises on the final chapter!
